channel.title: ElectroNuck
channel.description: Like a necromancer but for resurrecting old tech and forcing them to be musical instruments as well as willing other unholy abominations into existence.

videos.t: Turning a Thrift Store Telephone into a Synthesizer
videos.desc: The story of turning a nostalgic phone into a scope-creeped musical instrument.
